title: The generator's claim: each item at the lines of the work that give its Good, on a mend each item sent alone, and each choice the work rests on that the CCS leaves open, with why.

items.description: one for each item of every checklist; on a mend, one for each item sent to you alone

chosen.description: each choice the work rests on that neither the CCS nor the files it names gave, [] where none

made.description: an item made, at the lines of the work that give its Good

checklist.description: the checklist's path, as you were given it

item.description: the item's ID, such as B-1

lines.description: the lines of the work that give its Good, each range as `<path>:<from>-<to>`; for an item asked of each part, at least one range in every part of the work, each inside one part

choice.description: a choice you made that no one gave you
